verses.en: A Song, a Psalm of David.
verses.web: A Song. A Psalm by David.

verses.he: נָכֹ֣ון לִבִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה אַף־כְּבֹודִֽי׃
verses.ar: ثَابِتٌ قَلْبِي يَا ٱللهُ. أُغَنِّي وَأُرَنِّمُ. كَذَلِكَ مَجْدِي.
verses.en: My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.
verses.kjv: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.web: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

verses.ar: ٱسْتَيْقِظِي أَيَّتُهَا ٱلرَّبَابُ وَٱلْعُودُ. أَنَا أَسْتَيْقِظُ سَحَرًا.
verses.en: Awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake the dawn.
verses.kjv: Awake, psaltery and harp: I [myself] will awake early.
verses.web: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

verses.ar: أَحْمَدُكَ بَيْنَ ٱلشُّعُوبِ يَارَبُّ، وَأُرَنِّمُ لَكَ بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.en: I will give thanks unto Thee, O LORD, among the peoples; and I will sing praises unto Thee among the nations.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.web: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ رَحْمَتَكَ قَدْ عَظُمَتْ فَوْقَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ، وَإِلَى ٱلْغَمَامِ حَقُّكَ.
verses.en: For Thy mercy is great above the heavens, and Thy truth reacheth unto the skies.
verses.kjv: For thy mercy [is] great above the heavens: and thy truth [reacheth] unto the clouds.
verses.web: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

verses.he: ר֣וּמָה עַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבֹודֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: ٱرْتَفِعِ ٱللَّهُمَّ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ، وَلْيَرْتَفِعْ عَلَى كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَجْدُكَ.
verses.en: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; and Thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

verses.he: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הֹושִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: لِكَيْ يَنْجُوَ أَحِبَّاؤُكَ. خَلِّصْ بِيَمِينِكَ وَٱسْتَجِبْ لِي.
verses.en: That Thy beloved may be delivered, save with Thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.kjv: That thy beloved may be delivered: save [with] thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.web: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקָדְשֹׁ֗ו אֶעְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכֹּ֣ות אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
verses.ar: ٱللهُ قَدْ تَكَلَّمَ بِقُدْسِهِ: «أَبْتَهِجُ، أَقْسِمُ شَكِيمَ، وَأَقِيسُ وَادِيَ سُكُّوتَ.
verses.en: God spoke in His holiness, that I would exult; that I would divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.web: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

verses.he: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד ׀ לִ֤י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָעֹ֣וז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹקְקִֽי׃
verses.ar: لِي جِلْعَادُ، لِي مَنَسَّى. إِفْرَايِمُ خُوذَةُ رَأْسِي. يَهُوذَا صَوْلَجَانِي.
verses.en: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
verses.kjv: Gilead [is] mine; Manasseh [is] mine; Ephraim also [is] the strength of mine head; Judah [is] my lawgiver;
verses.web: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

verses.he: מֹואָ֤ב ׀ סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־אֱ֭דֹום אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עֲלֵֽי־פְ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת אֶתְרֹועָֽע׃
verses.ar: مُوآبُ مِرْحَضَتِيْ. عَلَى أَدُومَ أَطْرَحُ نَعْلِي. يَا فَلَسْطِينُ ٱهْتِفِي عَلَيَّ».
verses.en: Moab is my washpot; upon Edom do I cast my shoe; over Philistia do I cry aloud.
verses.kjv: Moab [is] my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.web: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

verses.he: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מִבְצָ֑ר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־אֱדֹֽום׃
verses.ar: مَنْ يَقُودُنِي إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ ٱلْمُحَصَّنَةِ؟ مَنْ يَهْدِينِي إِلَى أَدُومَ؟
verses.en: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me unto Edom?
verses.kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.web: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

verses.ar: أَلَيْسَ أَنْتَ يَا ٱللهُ ٱلَّذِي رَفَضْتَنَا، وَلَا تَخْرُجُ يَا ٱللهُ مَعَ جُيُوشِنَا؟
verses.en: Hast not Thou cast us off, O God? and Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts?
verses.kjv: [Wilt] not [thou], O God, [who] hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
verses.web: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

verses.he: הָֽבָה־לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָֽם׃
verses.ar: أَعْطِنَا عَوْنًا فِي ٱلضِّيقِ، فَبَاطِلٌ هُوَ خَلَاصُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ.
verses.en: Give us help against the adversary; for vain is the help of man.
verses.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain [is] the help of man.
verses.web: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

verses.ar: بِٱللهِ نَصْنَعُ بِبَأْسٍ، وَهُوَ يَدُوسُ أَعْدَاءَنَا.
verses.en: Through God we shall do valiantly; for He it is that will tread down our adversaries.
verses.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he [it is that] shall tread down our enemies.
verses.web: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
